verdict.rationale: Codex's `$skill-installer` installs individual skills from the openai/skills collection, either by name (e.g. `$skill-installer linear`, `$skill-installer gh-address-comments`, defaulting to `skills/.curated`) or by pointing at a single skill's GitHub directory URL (e.g. `.experimental/create-plan`). That lets a developer pick specific skills rather than taking the whole collection. Missing for 10: evidence that individual skills can be cherry-picked from within a bundled plugin (plugins install as a unit), and independent or hands-on corroboration of selective installs.
